metadata.verification_state: PRE-LAUNCH — launch-day verification task (ticket B-15) must flip all VERIFY/VERIFY_AT_LAUNCH statuses against the official FPL rules/help pages before the GW1 draft ships

status_legend.CONFIRMED: sourced to the official July 2026 FPL announcements or verified official pages
status_legend.VERIFY: best-known value carried from 2025/26 community/official tables; engine-usable but must be verified
status_legend.VERIFY_AT_LAUNCH: value believed unchanged for 2026/27 per announcements, but campaign plan mandates launch-day re-verification against the official rules page

sources: FPL official 2026/27 announcements as reported 20-23 Jul 2026 (fantasyfootballscout.co.uk, fantasyfootballfix.com, allaboutfpl.com, flashscore/tribalfootball roundups)
Official FPL rules/help pages (to be re-read in full at launch, ticket B-15)
metadata.note: Every value is an object {value, status[, note]}. The engine reads value regardless of status; statuses exist so unverified numbers are visible, tracked, and flipped at launch — never silently trusted.

points.note: announced unchanged for 2026/27; once per match at threshold

mid_fwd_threshold_cbirt.note: CBIT + ball recoveries; confirm FWD eligibility at launch

bps._note: 2026/27 announced changes are CONFIRMED; the remainder of the table is carried from 2025/26 community/official BPS tables with VERIFY status. Ticket B-15 pulls the authoritative full table from the official rules page and flips/corrects every row. Low-confidence rows carry an explicit note.

save_inside_box_extra.note: 2026/27 change: additional +1 for saving a shot from inside the box; the previous +1 for outside-box saves is removed

save_big_chance_extra.note: 2026/27 new: +1 for saving a big chance

penalty_save.note: 2026/27 change: reduced from 8; stacks with big-chance save BPS

recoveries_per.note: carried from 2025/26; low confidence on grouping — verify

tackles_won_each.note: net successful tackles; low confidence — verify exact definition

tackled_in_possession_each.note: 2026/27 change: the -1 BPS per time tackled is REMOVED

goals_conceded_gkp_def_each.note: LOW CONFIDENCE carried value — must verify at launch before the BPS backtest is treated as final on defenders

winning_goal.note: low confidence whether this remains in the table — verify

ranks.note: top three BPS scores in the match

tie_rule.value: ties share the higher award: tie for 1st -> both 3 and next gets 1; tie for 2nd -> both 2; tie for 3rd -> all tied get 1

formation_minimums.note: official wording specifies 1 GK, at least 3 DEF, at least 1 FWD; MID minimum of 2 is the arithmetic consequence — confirm official wording at launch

banked_fts_preserved_through_chip.note: believed carried from recent seasons (banked FTs retained when playing WC/FH); verify exact 2026/27 wording

no_afcon_extra_transfers.note: announced: no AFCON this season, no extra-transfer provision

structure.value: two sets of four chips, one set per half-season

expiry.note: GW19 deadline, 13:30 GMT Sat 2 Jan; unused set-1 chips expire and do not carry over

available_from.note: verify exact activation gameweek at launch

assistant_manager_chip_exists.note: 2026/27 announcements list only the four chips in two sets; campaign plan mandates confirming at launch that no Assistant Manager or other new chip exists

mechanism.value: rises/falls driven by net transfer activity; exact algorithm unpublished by FPL
mechanism.note: thresholds are not public; the rise-prediction model (ticket C-01) is empirical by design and scores itself against actual changes

change_window_uk.note: operationally observed window; nightly pull scheduled 03:00 to land after it

sell_price_rule.value: sell price = purchase price + floor(profit / 2) rounded down to nearest 0.1
sell_price_rule.note: 50% sell-on rule; verify official wording at launch

official_price_predictor_exists.note: 2026/27 new native feature: daily rise/fall predictions at 00:00 UK

trigger.value: starter registers 0 minutes in the gameweek

order.value: bench order priority, first legal substitution applies

scores_final_at.value: 09:00 UK time on the day after the gameweek's final match
scores_final_at.note: 2026/27 new rule: Opta post-match review window before points lock; Monday audit and pick settlement must honour this

live_updates.value: points, projected bonus (from 20 minutes into each match), mini-league standings and overall ranks update live
